heading: Requirements for use
lead: A railroad carrier may use or allow to be used a locomotive or tender on its railroad line only when the locomotive or tender and its parts and appurtenances—

tree.text: are in proper condition and safe to operate without unnecessary danger of personal injury;
have been inspected as required under this chapter and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Transportation under this chapter; and
can withstand every test prescribed by the Secretary under this chapter.
